subject: Goblin Warrior
picture: A small goblin warrior in a narrow stone dungeon corridor kicks a hanging lantern off its wall bracket. One foot stays planted on the floor. The other foot hits the lantern. He holds a crude sword and a small round shield. He has big pointed ears and a long nose. The corridor includes a stone ceiling, large block walls, large floor slabs, one wooden crate, and one fallen stone. The drawing reaches all four edges.
